grounding.from: The National Weather Service in Boulder said to expect partly sunny skies Tuesday

grounding.states: Tuesday high about 65°F, with other forecasts 64 to 67°F
grounding.from: The high is expected to reach 65 degrees; Weather Underground has a high of 64°F; AccuWeather has a high of 67°; 9NEWS has a high of 64

grounding.states: Tuesday wind north-northeast 6 to 10 mph, gusts up to 17 mph later
grounding.from: North-northeast winds of 6 to 10 mph are expected, becoming east to northeast in the afternoon with gusts up to 17 mph

grounding.states: Rain chance 30% after 3 p.m., rain moving in Tuesday evening
grounding.from: The weather service gives a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m.; with rain and showers possibly moving in Tuesday evening

grounding.states: Overnight low mid-40s to 44-46°F with rain showers at times
grounding.from: Weather Underground gives a low of 46°F with rain showers at times; AccuWeather gives a low of 44°

value.answer: Tuesday in Denver looks mostly sunny and mild, with a high around 65°F and light north-northeast wind. Rain moves in Tuesday evening, around 30% after 3 p.m. and climbing overnight, with lows in the mid-40s.
